# QoreX integrations

> Packages and guides for adding the QoreX wallet to dApps: RainbowKit/wagmi (EVM, EIP-6963 rdns network.qore.qorex), Interchain Kit and cosmos-kit (QoreChain native lane), Solana Wallet Standard; a mock wallet and Playwright fixtures for end-to-end tests. Apache-2.0.

Key facts: on QoreChain's native lane use `window.qorex.native.signAndBroadcast` (QoreX builds the transaction and adds the hybrid ML-DSA-87 signature); Amino is refused by design; EVM transactions on QoreChain need a registered ML-DSA-87 key and an EVM authorization window; QoreChain's SVM lane is not open yet. Check `window.qorex.native.capabilities` before using a feature. Chain ids: qorechain-vladi (mainnet, EVM 9801), qorechain-diana (testnet, EVM 9800).
